Our installs are clean, fast, and boring in the best way. We show up with everything staged in the truck. We walk the space with you, confirm placement, and get to work. # Competitor Intel Brief — 2026-06-16

# Section 1 — Executive Summary

Mermaid Water is running aggressive promotional bundling ($200 water heater discounts, $100 new customer promos, free installation on Kinetico systems) while positioning as a "one team" solution for water *and* plumbing in our Manassas backyard. EcoWater continues to lean on "Water Pro" dealer network and global credibility but shows no promotional urgency or pricing visibility. Hampton Roads is testing Richmond-area expansion (dual phone numbers now prominent) and emphasizing lifetime warranties with a Made-in-USA pitch. No competitor is leading with pricing transparency—creating a wedge opportunity for ClearWare if we're willing to test it.

# Section 2 — Per-competitor table

| Competitor | Hero positioning (one phrase) | Distinct services | Pricing visible? | Notable shift this week |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Mermaid Water** | "Test first, explain clearly, install to last" | Water treatment + full plumbing (heaters, drains, well/septic inspection); Kinetico dealer | Yes — $200 heater discount, $100 new customer, free install on select systems, free heater flush w/ softener | No change from prior week |
| **EcoWater** | "Global leader, local Water Pro network" | Softeners, filtration, smart home leak detection/conservation | No — free test only | No change from prior week |
| **Hampton Roads Water Services** | "Your full service water quality experts" | Testing, bacteria/virus treatment, hard water, taste/contamination | No — free test only | Dual area codes now prominent (Hampton Roads *and* Richmond); signals geographic expansion |

# Section 3 — Implications for ClearWave

- **Test promotional bundling**: Mermaid is stacking offers (discount + free add-on service). Consider pairing softener installs with free annual testing or heater flush to compete on perceived value without cutting base price.
- **Counter the "one team" plumbing narrative**: If we don't offer plumbing, partner visibly with a licensed shop and co-market; if we do, promote it harder—Mermaid is using it as a local convenience wedge.
- **Experiment with visible pricing tiers**: Every competitor hides pricing behind "free test." A simple "Softener packages from $X" or "Typical whole-home system: $X–$Y" page could differentiate and capture bottom-funnel searchers tired of obligation calls.

# Section 4 — Watch items

- **Hampton Roads Richmond push**: Confirm whether they've opened a Richmond office or just phone routing. If brick-and-mortar, assess whether they're targeting our service area next.
- **Mermaid promo duration**: Track how long the $200/$100 offers run—if extended past Q2, it signals margin pressure or aggressive growth targets worth matching.
- **EcoWater dealer activity**: No site change, but check if local EcoWater franchisee is running independent promos or undercutting on Google Ads in our zip codes.
